BrochureContent.Content:
CME are excited to bring to the market this spacious 2 bedroom/2 bathroom ground floor apartment nestled in this conveniently located development. Presented in very good condition throughout, No. 23 provides spacious accommodation with a large open plan lounge and dining area along with a partially concealed fully fitted and upgraded kitchen. Both bedrooms are of double proportions with the master providing an ensuite shower room. New flooring has been installed throughout and the kitchen has been upgraded to provide new appliances, making this apartment ready to move into. No. 23 is positioned overlooking very well maintained communal gardens to the front and rear and is within walking distance of all the amenities of Sallins including shops, coffee shops, supermarket and train station as well as being just a short stroll from the beautiful Canal Greenway. Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment with sole agents CME 045-897711.
.
